liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Victim Or The Crime** (5 reviews): Source singles out the Victim into Foolish Heart sequence as the reason to get the show; Highlight is the sparkling jam between Victim and Foolish Heart [9][10][11][16][19]
- **Foolish Heart** (2 reviews): Source says the development of Foolish Heart was a strong point of the show; The mid-Foolish Heart jam was climactic; reviewer unsure whether Jerry returned for the final verse before It's All Too Much [8][17]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Opening with Greatest Story was a nice surprise [17]
- **Eternity** (1 review): Source says the development of Eternity was a strong point of the show [8]
- **Drums** (1 review): Drums and Space were also cool, per the reviewer [19]

## Setlist highlights

- **It's All Too Much**: rare: 6 archived performances [20]

## The recordings

- **gd95-06-27.schoeps.10180.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 164 min; rated 2.59/5 by 17 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording; sound quality could be better, but acceptable for an audience tape; Audience sound is elusive and tired, but authentic to the reel; Audience recording with some crowd noise, which the reviewer likes as it recalls being there [9][12][13]
- **gd1995-06-27.fob.schoeps.unknown.larson.35123.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 160 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1995-06-27.fob.nak701.unknown.83248.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 161 min [3]
- **gd1995-06-27.pmz-nak.holtz.92185.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 165 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Indoor arena on an otherwise outdoor summer tour; reviewer tailgated in their hometown lot with friends [12]
- Seventeen-year-old attendee wandered the Palace parking lot alone and ran into three younger high school friends looking for a place to pee [15]
- Reviewer found both Detroit Palace shows among the best of 1995, though they heard few other '95 shows [9]
- Rest of the show is reasonably solid for summer 1995; the Palace shows had a good vibe [10]
- Reviewer calls it possibly the best Victim>Foolish ever, apart from RFK, and some of the tour's best playing [16]
- Reviewer thinks these may be the weakest of the Palace shows over the years; second set was better [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd95-06-27.schoeps.10180.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Henry Wankleswurth and Chris L.; source: Audience: Schoeps MK4's [1]. Also: Audience recording with Schoeps CMC4 microphones, to DAT, then CDR; via Henry Wankleswurth, seeded to etree by neolevo [1]
- **gd1995-06-27.fob.schoeps.unknown.larson.35123.flac16**: transferred by Chris Larson; source: FOB>SchoepsMK-4V>D3 [2]
- **gd1995-06-27.fob.nak701.unknown.83248.flac16**: source: Nakamichi 701s -> Reutelhuber -> Casio DA-7 (16/48) [3]
- **gd1995-06-27.pmz-nak.holtz.92185.flac16**: taped by Greg Holtz; transferred by JAZ; source: Nakamichi CM-300 w/CP-4-PZM mix-> D7 @ 16/48kHz [4]
